prompt: The storyteller is still reading, and an attendant is getting the booth ready. What should the attendant do?
promptZh: 說故事的人還在朗讀，服務人員正在準備聆聽室。服務人員該怎麼做？

options.text: Keep the booth door open and start the first turn as soon as the booth is ready.
options.zh: 讓聆聽室的門開著，一準備好就讓第一組使用。
options.whyZh: 應開門讓候用家庭聽到叫名，但必須等故事講完才開始使用。

options.text: Keep the booth door open, but wait for the story to end before starting turns.
options.zh: 讓聆聽室的門開著，但等故事講完才開始輪流使用。
options.whyZh: 門開著能讓等候者聽見叫名；使用開始仍以主廳故事講完為準。

options.text: Keep the booth door closed and wait for the story to end before starting turns.
options.zh: 讓聆聽室的門關著，等故事講完才開始輪流使用。
options.whyZh: 等待時點對，但講者交代門保持開著，方便等候家庭聽到叫名。

options.text: Keep the booth door closed and start the first turn while the story is still going.
options.zh: 讓聆聽室的門關著，趁故事還在講時讓第一組使用。
options.whyZh: 門應開著；也不能在故事結束前讓人使用。

explanationZh: 門開著能讓等候者聽見叫名；使用開始仍以主廳故事講完為準。
evidence: If you want to use the listening booth today, please wait until the storyteller has finished in the main room. / We leave the booth door open so that families can hear their names when we call them.

evidenceSpans.speaker: N
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If you want to use the listening booth today, please wait until the storyteller has finished in the main room.

evidenceSpans.speaker: N
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We leave the booth door open so that families can hear their names when we call them.

vocabulary.note: 在此負責準備聆聽區，而非正在另一個房間說故事的人。
